title: Vague adjective user-friendly + weak modal
expected_flags: vague adjective (user-friendly); weak modal (should); no measurable usability criterion

title: Vague adverb quickly + no threshold
requirement_text: The page should load quickly on all devices.
expected_flags: vague adverb (quickly); weak modal (should); no time threshold; unspecified device scope

title: Implementation detail disguised as requirement
requirement_text: The system shall use React for the user interface.
expected_flags: implementation constraint (React); not a behavioral requirement; no testable outcome

title: Vague verb + undefined scope (user story)
requirement_text: As a user, I want a new feature added to the product so that I can be more productive.
expected_flags: vague noun (new feature); vague outcome (more productive); no acceptance criteria; no specific behavior

title: Multiple ambiguities + passive voice
requirement_text: The system should display user data appropriately and errors should be handled properly.
expected_flags: vague verb (display, handled); escape clause (appropriately, properly); passive voice (should be handled); weak modal (should)

title: Vague qualifier regular intervals
requirement_text: The product shall provide status messages at regular intervals not less than every 60 seconds.
expected_flags: partially specified; regular intervals is redundant/vague; ambiguous whether 60s is minimum or maximum

title: Tacit knowledge + undefined process
requirement_text: The system shall enhance the standard onboarding flow to streamline user activation.
expected_flags: vague verb (enhance, streamline); tacit knowledge (standard onboarding flow); no measurable improvement; no baseline

title: Happy-path only + vague success
requirement_text: WHEN a customer completes payment, THE SYSTEM SHALL display a success confirmation within 3 seconds.
expected_flags: happy-path-only (no failure/timeout/duplicate-payment branch); otherwise valid EARS structure

title: Well-formed EARS (negative control)
requirement_text: IF the sensor reading exceeds 100 degrees Celsius, THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL trigger the emergency shutdown within 500 milliseconds.
expected_flags: none expected; valid Unwanted Behavior EARS; single SHALL; clear trigger/response

title: Oblique symbol + vague noun + weak modal
requirement_text: The app should support push/email notifications for relevant updates.
expected_flags: oblique symbol (push/email); vague adjective (relevant); weak modal (should); vague verb (support)
